response_text: Yes. If how we track the number of threads running has been implemented correctly, then the round robin will just repeatedly schedule the singular thread since the singular thread still yields to the OS. Assuming that we begin indexing our threads at the 0th element of the thread array, next thread = (current thread + 1) % num_threads running will give (1 % 1) == 0, and thus the 0th thread will be scheduled.\n
